name: Standard Welcome Letter
body:
Dear {{first_name}},

Welcome to DSTA! We are delighted to have you join us as an intern and look forward to a rewarding experience together.

Your internship is scheduled to commence on {{start_date}} and conclude on {{end_date}}. Please report to DSTA Main Building (71 Science Park Drive, Singapore 118253) at 8:30 AM on your first day. You will be greeted by your assigned coordinator at the main reception.

Your Project

  Programme   :  {{programme_name}}
  Project     :  {{project_title}}
  Supervisor  :  {{supervisor_name}}

Please bring along the following on your first day:

  • Original NRIC / Passport for verification
  • Student pass (if applicable)
  • Your most recent academic transcript or letter of enrolment

Your supervisor and team are excited to work with you. Should you have any questions before your start date, please do not hesitate to reach out to us at internship@dsta.gov.sg.

We look forward to welcoming you on board!

Warm regards,
Internship Office
Defence Science and Technology Agency (DSTA)
71 Science Park Drive, Singapore 118253
internship@dsta.gov.sg

name: Credit-Bearing Welcome Letter
body:
Dear {{first_name}},

Welcome to DSTA! We are pleased to confirm your internship commencement and look forward to a rewarding and enriching experience together.

Your internship is scheduled to commence on {{start_date}} and conclude on {{end_date}}. Please report to DSTA Main Building (71 Science Park Drive, Singapore 118253) at 8:30 AM on your first day.

Your Project

  Programme   :  {{programme_name}}
  Project     :  {{project_title}}
  Supervisor  :  {{supervisor_name}}

As this is a credit-bearing internship, please note the following:

  • You are responsible for fulfilling all academic requirements stipulated by {{school}} for the award of credit.
  • Please ensure your school's Industrial Attachment (IA) approval documentation is submitted to your programme coordinator prior to commencement.
  • Any academic reports, timesheets, or assessments required by {{school}} remain your responsibility to complete and submit on time.

Please bring along the following on your first day:

  • Original NRIC / Passport for verification
  • Student pass (if applicable)
  • Letter of authorisation / IA approval from {{school}}
  • Your most recent academic transcript or letter of enrolment

Should you have any questions before your start date, please do not hesitate to reach out to us at internship@dsta.gov.sg.

We look forward to welcoming you on board!

Warm regards,
Internship Office
Defence Science and Technology Agency (DSTA)
71 Science Park Drive, Singapore 118253
internship@dsta.gov.sg
